title: Vedar — Kamchatka travel
description: Kamchatka travel: tours with availability, volcano/safety status, weather, stays, transfers, car rental, trip plans. Seven state-changing tools (readOnlyHint=false, live 2026-10-30): make_trip_plan and edit_trip_plan persist an anonymous 7-day trip-plan draft by plan_id (no personal data, nothing sent to a human or operator; not idempotent); create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request, request_charter and create_car_rental_request send the user's name/phone to the platform/operator/provider and require prior confirmation with consent:true. No online payment. Safety info cites source and update time; not a safety guarantee.

authentication.reason: Public endpoint, no credentials; initialize and tools/list verified without auth on 2026-10-19.

probe.reason: Unauthenticated initialize returned vedar-mcp 2.10.0 (protocol 2025-06-18); tools/list returned 23 tools, seven with readOnlyHint=false: make_trip_plan and edit_trip_plan (anonymous 7-day draft writes, no personal data) and create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request, request_charter, create_car_rental_request (consent:true required, name/phone). No write tool was called.
